files.notebook.md:
Intro.
# Tasks
## Fix the reaper
It leaks.
# Notes
Done.

steps.line: * Given a notebook with the lines "Intro.", "# Tasks", "## Fix the reaper", "It leaks.", "# Notes" and "Done." is open

expect.why: the whole notebook file is open

expect.that: [.opened.json.sections.notebook.drawn[].text | rtrimstr("\n")] == ["Intro.", "# Tasks", "## Fix the reaper", "It leaks.", "# Notes", "Done."]
expect.why: the notebook shows its six lines, in order

steps.line: * When the user chooses View > Fold All
* Then only "Intro.", "# Tasks" and "# Notes" are visible

expect.why: the window shows only Intro., # Tasks and # Notes, in order
the lines shown are the notebook's own Intro., # Tasks and # Notes lines
each of the three lines is on screen inside the window
the other lines are hidden, not removed from the notebook
